BUSINESS STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Name the president

2. Which statement about Entrepreneurship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Entrepreneurship never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship.
   D. Treat Entrepreneurship as rumours only.

3. Which statement about Marketing is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Marketing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Marketing.
   C. Say Marketing never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Marketing as rumours only.

4. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Avoiding all community work

5. Which statement about Public Finance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Public Finance.
   B. Say Public Finance never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Public Finance as rumours only.
   D. Explain Public Finance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Which statement about Trial Balance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Trial Balance as rumours only.
   B. Say Trial Balance never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Trial Balance.
   D. Explain Trial Balance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. Which statement about Cash Books is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Cash Books never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Cash Books as rumours only.
   C. Explain Cash Books with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Cash Books.

8. Which statement about Financial Markets is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Financial Markets.
   B. Explain Financial Markets with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Financial Markets as rumours only.
   D. Say Financial Markets never happens in Kenya.

9. Which statement about The Ledger is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing The Ledger.
   B. Treat The Ledger as rumours only.
   C. Say The Ledger never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain The Ledger with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. Which statement about Savings and Investments is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Savings and Investments.
   B. Treat Savings and Investments as rumours only.
   C. Explain Savings and Investments with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Savings and Investments never happens in Kenya.

11. Which statement about Procurement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Procurement as rumours only.
   B. Explain Procurement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Procurement.
   D. Say Procurement never happens in Kenya.

12. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

13. Which statement about Types of Business Ownership is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Types of Business Ownership.
   B. Explain Types of Business Ownership with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Types of Business Ownership as rumours only.
   D. Say Types of Business Ownership never happens in Kenya.

14. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Nakuru
   C. Kisumu
   D. Nairobi

15. Which statement about Methods of Price Determination is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Methods of Price Determination with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Methods of Price Determination as rumours only.
   C. Say Methods of Price Determination never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Methods of Price Determination.

16. Which statement about Consumer and Investor Protection is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Consumer and Investor Protection never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Consumer and Investor Protection with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Consumer and Investor Protection as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Consumer and Investor Protection.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Economic Planning and Development in Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain International Trade and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Types of Business Ownership and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Methods of Price Determination and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Entrepreneurship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Procurement and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
